NEIGHBORHOOD._Description:
See attached addendum. he subject neighborhood is located in a neighborhood with all commercial and support services in close proximity to the subject property. Access to the neighborhood is by Highway 18 & 34. There are no adverse factors which affect the neighborhood in general or the subject property in particular. Schools, shopping, and all other recreational support facilities can be found within the general market area. The residences within this market area vary between bungalows, ranch/modern style homes, one/two story homes, and large custom built homes on larger tracts of land.
There is a wide range of housing in the area. Due to the wide range of housing in the area, whether a property's value falls 15% above or below the predominant price does not negatively affect marketability. The variations in the predominant price are due to a multitude of features, such as age, lot size, gross living area, condition, etc. which, for the subject property, are identified throughout the appraisal report.
The price and age data reflects MLS data over the past year within the neighborhood boundaries. There are extremes which are not accounted for in that data.
Neighborhood Market Conditions: Mortgage interest rates are typically in the 6.27% to 7.25% range with loan discounts, interest buydowns, and concessions being offered at the present time. Seller concessions are generally part of the negotiation process. See the attached 1004MC for additional market data.
The market value stated in this report reflects a marketing time under 3 months. The market value stated in this report reflects an exposure time under 3 months.
Comments on other Land Use: 25% Other land uses are vacant land which consists of state property, City/Town Property, residential developable & undevelopable land, parking lots, land for non-residential use property, industrial developable land, etc.
Highest and Best Use - Zoned: The subject is zoned as agricultural District. Legal improvement uses are limited to agricultural use and permitted complementary uses. The value of the subject as improved exceeds the value as vacant. The subject is located in a neighborhood characterized by residential properties, and a change in land use is not likely in the near future. Therefore, the highest and best use of the subject is its present single-family residential use.
Flood designation status is from an independent source and should be confirmed by the lender from their source.
The subject could be rebuilt (100% of the original footprint of the dwelling) as is in the event of a fire or other similar catastrophe, according to Local Inspectional Services Department.
Adverse Site Conditions: Any adverse easements, encroachments, legal description and lot dimensions should be verified by a current Plat of Survey and Title Policy. Any minor variations in lot dimensions should not effect value.

Physical Deficiencies or Conditions : There are no known apparent adverse environmental conditions that would negatively impact on the value of the property. However, this should be verified by a qualified environmental engineer.

SALES_COMPARISON._Comment: Extensive research was made in the market place for sales similar in style, size, location and characteristic to the subject property. The sales selected by the appraiser were chosen for their similarity to the subject. Where necessary, appropriate adjustments have been made to the comparable sales. It is the appraisers opinion that the sales used are the best available. Together, the comparables cited describe the range of values for the subject property and support the various adjustments made. See attached addendum.
